item.title: Bokura no Ikinari Dousei Keikaku!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Honkijiru
  • 発売日: 2007-12-07
  • スコア: 6.220000000000001/10 (7 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 僕らのいきなり同棲計画!
  • 英語名: Bokura no Ikinari Dousei Keikaku!

あらすじ

Keisuke is a high school student, who has just moved to a new school. Michiko, his new classroom teacher, takes him to his new apartment, but there are also two girls, Ayana and Ruiko, waiting him in front of the apartment. Michiko says to them, “You now start living together here.” They are forced to lend Michiko a hand to invent a brain stimulant drugs. No one knows how it works…. But when they take it, Ayana and Ruiko get sexually excited. What will happen to them in the end…?

item.title: Ore no Megami-sama!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Honkijiru
  • 発売日: 2007-05-25
  • スコア: 5.46/10 (9 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 俺の女神さまっ！
  • 英語名: Ore no Megami-sama!

あらすじ

One day, Yuya starts to live at his uncle’s house alone. But two weeks later, a goddess appears in front of him. Her name is Rean, and she comes to his place to be his wife following the god’s order. He thinks it must be a dream, and orders her to give him a blow job. On the next day, when he wakes up, there is still Rean in the bed together with him. Aira, Rean’s older sister, and Cachua, Rean’s younger sister, also come to his place, and they start to live together…. Yukiko, his girlfriend, gets furious to hear that, and starts to live at his place as well….

あらすじ

Tatsuya has a wife, Chizuru. They used to love each other, love passionately. But, their love gradually becomes colder and colder…. One day, when he is on his way home, he sees Chizuru walking with a man. He stops them, and asks them what’s going on. Another man stops their quarrel, and tells them that he is a boss of a swapping club. He gets interested in it, and visits the club room with Chizuru…

item.title: Wakaoku-sama Misaki ~Dakarete Modaete Nagasarete~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Honkijiru
  • 発売日: 2005-02-25
  • スコア: 6.2700000000000005/10 (7 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 若奥さま美咲～抱かれて悶えて流されて～
  • 英語名: Wakaoku-sama Misaki Dakarete Modaete Nagasarete

あらすじ

Asakawa Misaki, a typical housewife in an arranged marriage, yearns for more affection from her husband, who often prioritizes work over their relationship. When her daughter is abducted and then rescued by a mysterious man named Kotou Shin, who ends up being injured in a process, Misaki feels indebted to him for saving her child. However, unbeknownst to her, Shin is not the hero he appears to be; he’s a fixer hired to engineer a scheme aimed at breaking up her family. Unaware of the deception, Misaki finds herself drawn into a world of moral corruption orchestrated by Shin.
